steps.caption: Estimate & invoice defaults
steps.narration: The CRM adds sales tax to a new estimate from the rate you set. Here is where to set it.

steps.selector: text=Fallback when no city or division rate matches
steps.caption: Fallback rate
steps.narration: Default sales tax is the rate used when no city or division rate matches the job.

steps.caption: Default sales tax (%)
steps.narration: Type your rate as a percent. As an example, we'll use eight and a quarter.

steps.caption: Save defaults
steps.narration: Choose Save defaults. Check your own rates with your accountant.

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Now let's see it on a new estimate. Open Estimates.

steps.caption: Imani Brewster
steps.narration: We'll pick Imani Brewster, in Dallas.

steps.caption: Price book
steps.narration: Find the work in your price book.

steps.caption: Quantity
steps.narration: Set the quantity, then choose Review.

steps.caption: Review
steps.narration: Review shows the estimate before it's saved.

steps.caption: Added automatically
steps.narration: The review step says sales tax is added automatically.

steps.caption: Total with tax
steps.narration: Once it's saved, the total includes the tax.

steps.caption: Open this estimate
steps.narration: Open it to see the detail.

steps.caption: Tax line
steps.narration: Tax has its own line, between the subtotal and the total.

steps.caption: Menu: Settings
steps.narration: You'll find the rate in Settings, under Estimate and invoice defaults.

youtube.title: How to set your default sales tax | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the default sales tax in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will set the rate in Settings, then write a new estimate and see the tax on its own line above the total. The CRM uses the rates you enter, so check them with your accountant.
